scope: Four source-specific experiments. Counts overlap across providers and are not a global unique-match total.
current_season_scope: 2026/27 result and Understat summaries were refreshed on 2026-10-14. Native Wyscout events and Metrica/SkillCorner tracking below are historical samples.
artifact_policy: This file contains aggregate metrics. Native records, identities, neighbors, predictions, weights and complete source receipts are archived in the local warehouse.

metric_definitions.completion_rate_known: successful / (successful + unsuccessful + offside); missing or other outcomes remain separate categories.
metric_definitions.possession_danger: Legacy supplier boolean label: linked specification describes a 90-second target. It is not the new EPV total.
metric_definitions.regain_rate_known: regain / (regain + disruption); unknown and conflict remain in all-chain counts and are excluded from known-outcome rates.
metric_definitions.supplier_epv: Supplier estimates: 2026 EPV documentation specifies 30 seconds or interruption. For and against components remain separate; total equals delta_for minus delta_against.
metric_definitions.xthreat: Legacy supplier scoring-danger estimate: 10-second target; option values may be evaluated at an option-specific retrospective peak.

limits: Supplier models are not executed, reproduced, trained, calibrated, or causally validated here.
Release options are only linked passing_option rows with supplier availability True. Targeted False or unknown availability never enters that denominator.
Joins require the same match, period, and attacking team, and an overlapping possession interval. A release flag outside the option interval is separately reported.
Option peak values and event phase/structure labels can use future frames. Aggregate legacy descriptors are retrospective; no alternative ranking or decision model is fitted.
Later complete matches are a descriptive holdout cohort. There are no predictive evaluation scores or claims of out-of-sample model accuracy.
False fully_extrapolated does not prove every frame was detected. Missing quality fields remain unknown; quality flags do not silently filter observations.
Coordinates outside nominal pitch extents are retained without clipping; examples and source hashes preserve their audit trail.
Chain-associated EPV describes distinct opponent possession spells within each chain. A spell can occur in multiple chains; this is not additive pressing credit or causal value.
The local public broadcast-tracking sample is not a global player ranking or evidence of coach intent.

pressing_chains.epv_weighting: Equal weight per contributing chain, after averaging distinct linked opponent possession spells within that chain; n counts chains with that component. Spells can occur in multiple chains. No additive or causal credit.

Equal weight per contributing chain, after averaging distinct linked opponent possession spells within that chain; n counts chains with that component. Spells can occur in multiple chains. No additive or causal credit.

Equal weight per contributing chain, after averaging distinct linked opponent possession spells within that chain; n counts chains with that component. Spells can occur in multiple chains. No additive or causal credit.

passing.cohort_method: Complete matches sorted by UTC kickoff; latest approximately 20 percent, with tied kickoffs kept together.
passing.conclusion: Release-time options and unknown-aware pressing chains are available for descriptive analysis. Supplier estimates remain retrospective descriptors.

configuration.selection: validation mean binary log loss; separate classifier heads selected independently

budgets_per_seed.gru_context: 1 shared encoder, 2 binary heads, maximum 12 epochs, patience 3
budgets_per_seed.logistic_context: 6 binary logistic fits: 3 C choices per head, max_iter=1000
budgets_per_seed.tree_context: 4 trees: 2 depths per head, minimum leaf size 60

compute.fairness: Identical sampled native states/targets and CPU thread cap. Logistic/tree/GRU share all input information. xT-location uses current location plus xT learned from ALL accepted training-match passes/shots, followed by calibration on the same sampled states. This hybrid baseline has extra training-event exposure. Search, parameter and elapsed compute budgets are not equal.
compute.timing_scope: Per-method fitting and validation selection; classifier timing also includes small numeric weight serialization. Excludes final heldout inference. Data loading/xT fitting are shared preprocessing.

limits: One historical league-season; no cross-season or production validation.
Native Wyscout event counts, duel duplication and stoppage conventions differ from SPADL and published VAEP.
Observed spell boundaries shorten the target horizon; missing goal metadata inconsistencies are excluded, not repaired.
Inputs use recorded event-start type/location and history, not tracking, pressure, intended outcomes, or unobserved alternatives.
Rare conceding labels limit reliability estimates; predictive association is not causal action value.
Methods use documented small search budgets, not matched elapsed training compute; accuracy alone is not an efficiency comparison.

The xT-location hybrid fits its grid on every accepted training match, then its logistic map on the capped training states. Its extra training-event exposure prevents architecture-only comparisons with capped-state classifiers.
Match bootstrap omits training-set resampling and hyperparameter-selection uncertainty; seed SD is not a confidence interval.
Raw xT uses only native pass transitions and attacking shots; own goals terminate moves and are not attacking-shot successes.

semantics.baseline: Training-fitted logistic map of raw training-only xT plus current x/y to each shared fixed-horizon target; empirical calibration is assessed on heldout matches, not assumed.
semantics.eligibility: Native eventId 8 pass with valid observed start/time; endpoint and completion do not determine inclusion.
semantics.goals: Attacking shot/free-kick-shot/penalty tag101, any non-keeper own-goal102 credited to opponent; keeper event9 duplicates ignored; metadata mismatch excludes whole match.
semantics.horizon: Current pass plus next horizon-1 native events, truncated at spell boundary; not seconds or SPADL actions.
semantics.spell: Turnovers retained; terminate after goal/foul/interruption/offside, before free-kick restart, or at match/period boundary. No inferred time-gap or possession reset.
semantics.state: P(score)-P(concede) before pass outcome; not realized incremental VAEP or offensive action gain.

paired_match_bootstrap.estimand: Per-event mean log loss difference; seed losses averaged, test matches resampled jointly. Negative favors GRU. Conditional on fixed trained models and sampled examples.

raw_xt.interpretation: Training-only eventual attacking shot/move value; not calibrated to the fixed native-event horizon. Raw grid is descriptive only.
raw_xt.method: Empirical shot/move Markov model; failed moves terminate with zero goal value

value.conclusion: GRU score log loss is worse than logistic context and the xT-location hybrid on this holdout. Only 14 concede-positive test states limit that comparison. The hybrid uses extra training-event exposure; compute budgets differ.

method.nearest: Nearest team distance, ties assigned equally
method.gaussian: Velocity-directed shifted anisotropic Gaussian influence, normalized team shares
method.arrival: Reaction projection + constant-speed arrival, logistic timing uncertainty, symmetric competing control hazards after ball travel
method.integration: Midpoint hazards with exact exponential survival loss, extended precision accumulation, explicit remaining mass; no probability clipping or renormalization
method.array_layout: nearest/gaussian/arrival: snapshot, team, flattened target; uncontrolled: snapshot,target; identity arrays and JSONL use same snapshot order

coordinates.x_axis: length, positive in supplier increasing-x direction
coordinates.y_axis: width, positive down in Metrica normalized coordinates
coordinates.orientation_policy: supplier directions when available; otherwise unknown
coordinates.detection_provenance: unknown; legacy detected mask indicates finite coordinates only

method.offside_filter: not applied because attacking orientation is unknown

limitations: Teaching parameters are uncalibrated; no validated real reception prediction or predictive score.
Gaussian influence, arrival control and nearest distance are different assumptions, not ground truth.
Metrica supplier detection/extrapolation provenance is unknown; complete finite supplied geometry only.
Metrica CSV pitch dimensions 105x68m are nominal assumptions, not measured metadata.
Causal velocities exclude missing history, clock gaps and speeds above 12m/s; no interpolation or centered filtering.
Two-pass streamed full-match coverage, 240 requested snapshots by default; eligible-only sampling may favor clean tracking.
Outside-pitch coordinates are retained and flagged; no offside, interception along pass path, aerial ball or player-specific calibration.
Clock experiment uses supervised early native-frame anchors with synthetic constant offsets, not blind alignment or clock drift validation.
SkillCorner inspection is only its first 1000 valid-clock frames; no whole-match/provider coverage inference.

config.sampling: systematic uniformly spaced ranks over whole-match eligible frames

anchor_position_diagnostic.note: Spatial residual at native frame IDs only; coordinates do not train the supervised clock fit

sampling.sampling: Systematic equally spaced ranks across the complete whole-match eligible-frame sequence; no prefix truncation
sampling.bias: Uniform over eligible frames, not uniform wall-clock time; missing ball/velocity intervals have no samples

synchronization.method: Supervised median constant-clock calibration from early native Start Frame anchors, per period
synchronization.split: First 20% of unique event timestamps for anchors; strictly later timestamps held out
synchronization.truth: Native Metrica event Start Frame; never replaced by a nearest timestamp match
synchronization.claim: Synthetic constant offset recovery only; not blind Needleman-Wunsch or heterogeneous drift validation

tracking_identity.hash_scope: raw bytes from file start through last inspected native frame, inclusive

space.conclusion: The three assumed control surfaces differ materially on the same 240 eligible frames. These differences measure model sensitivity; spatial control accuracy has no external ground truth here. Clock validation recovers injected constant offsets using native early anchors.

next_season_prediction.estimator: Train-only standardized ridge; alpha chosen on 2022 input validation; no refitting on test.

limits: xGChain and xGBuildup are attributed possession involvement measures, never additive player causal credit or team totals.
Same-league consecutive returners and two-half players must meet exposure thresholds; absent players and league switchers are excluded.

Bootstrap intervals are conditional on selected player panels, fixed fitted models and fixed neighbor graphs; repeated rows are clustered by provider player ID. Neighbor graph dependence between different players is not captured.
Understat composite source positions are retained. S denotes substitute; position-specific minutes and actual coaching duties are unavailable.
Multiple-club Understat season totals stay at league/player grain; SDK first-listed club receives no attribution.
2026/27 is partial descriptive coverage with a separate 270-minute threshold, never a completed training/evaluation target or growth estimate.
Native Wyscout duels are event records, not SPADL actions. Frequency features include every outcome and unknown outcome.
Wyscout performance ratios use only known-outcome passing/duel subsets from the existing extractor; missing denominators exclude a player from both models.
Broad static Wyscout roles are source labels. Stable neighbors do not establish quality, development potential, transfer suitability or causal roles.
Understat and Wyscout identities and analyses remain separate; no cross-provider player matching is attempted.

wyscout.candidate_rule: Same eligible player IDs in both halves within league/source role; self excluded; k=5; minimum cohort=20.
wyscout.scaling: StandardScaler fitted separately to each early-half league/role cohort, reused unchanged on late-half.
wyscout.minutes: Supplied PlayeRank exposure for outfield players; nominal formation/substitution/red-card regular-time intervals for omitted goalkeepers.

buildup.conclusion: Buildup/chain features reduce next-season buildup MAE on 1,823 historical returner pairs. Frequency-only style neighbors overlap more between halves, although absolute overlap is low. Current-season profiles are partial descriptive summaries.

unittest.skip_scope: Optional dependency tests for existing features; available numerical models exercised.

archive.scope: Current four analysis runs only; full source warehouse integrity not rerun.
archive.snapshot_policy: Repeated report/provenance timestamps under the same source/code/config run ID retain immutable byte revisions.
